title: Mask Email
prompt: An account page wants to hide most of a user's email address. Write a function that keeps the first character before @, replaces the rest of the name with three asterisks, and keeps the domain unchanged.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Mask Email, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: An account page wants to hide most of a user's email address. Write a function that keeps the first character before @, replaces the rest of the name with three asterisks, and keeps the domain unchanged. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
